summary: BTC is trading near all-time highs after a 17% correction from March peaks, with Cred viewing this as a typical shakeout pattern before trend continuation. Key support at $61k-$62k has already held twice, while $68.4k serves as a critical level that should not be lost on a daily closing basis. Funding rates and open interest have spiked, creating conditions where shorts during consolidation could fuel the next leg higher. ETH/USD is showing potential for swing traders at the $3k support and $3.9k breakout levels, though ETH/BTC remains uninteresting.
